'''Clan Konshi''' was a [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] family line. Members of this clan distinguished themselves by a blue chevron [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] on each of their cheeks. The clan had a historical feud with [[Clan Moxla]].

The clan produced at least one [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]], [[Shigar Konshi]].
